ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio; approximately 85-90% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 10-15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels, primarily driven by localized barnacle clusters and transient water spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigment across the majority of the surface area. High-contrast white geometric blobs are concentrated at the distal tips (apex) of both the left and right lobes. Multiple isolated high-intensity point features are scattered across the central surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an approximate vertex angle of 40-45 degrees, showing a well-defined separation of the lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude along the medial-to-distal portions of the trailing edge. The serrations appear more pronounced and jagged on the inner sections adjacent to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the lateral edges, tapering to sharp points at the distal apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme tips of both lobes, indicative of extensive barnacle colonization. Smaller, individual circular points are detected on the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower interior quadrant of the right lobe, appearing as lighter parallel lines against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacles at the lobe tips, altering the natural geometric contour of the edges in those regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity transient noise features (water droplets) suspended in the air across the entire image plane.
